scenarios.name: task-success
scenarios.description: Agent must find the correct deploy config in top-1. Calibration boost (×3.0) lifts the signal above a higher-relevance noise fact that the baseline cannot distinguish.

scenarios.name: re-ask-rate
scenarios.description: Agent must not need a second search to find the auth token. Calibration boost lifts the signal above a higher-relevance stale doc that the baseline surfaces first.

scenarios.name: noise-injection
scenarios.description: Top-3 must contain at most 1 noise fact. The signal sits just under the recall floor in the baseline arm; the real ×3.0 useful-boost lifts it over while ×0.5 noise-demotions pull two confirmed-noise facts under the floor, cutting injection by 2.

scenarios.name: stale-surface
scenarios.description: Expired config (valid_to 2025) must not appear in top-3. Stale-veto (×0.5) is active in both arms; the extra confirmed-noise boost (×0.5) compounds it below the recall floor only in the calibration arm, dropping the stale fact entirely.

scenarios.name: recall-cost
scenarios.description: Recall-path cost (facts cleared floor and scored) must fall by at least 1 in the calibration arm. Calibration prunes confirmed-noise below the recall floor, so the useful fact is still cleared while less scoring work is done — the efficiency outcome issue #271 asks for.
